description: Read-only. Get full details for a specific API service: endpoints with schemas, pricing and ready-to-use proxy URLs, plus quality data. Services with many endpoints (25 or more, organised into groups) return a list of endpoint groups instead of every endpoint; call again with group set to one of those names to get that group's endpoints. Does not call any upstream API or debit credits.

group.description: Optional endpoint group name from endpoint_groups (case-insensitive), e.g. 'Match'. Returns only that group's endpoints. Use 'all' to force every endpoint of a large service.

name: apihub_get_service
